gaps.explanation: detail[] records the p9-10 all-funds schedule gross per fund: General 615 + Library 6,848 + Street 130,165 = 137,628. The p5 governmental funds statement combines General and Library into one General column and nets their internal transfer: Transfers - in 615 + 130,165 = 130,780. Library transfer in 6,848 (p9) = gap -6,848; it is the same money as the 6,848 inside the General transfers out (167,023 on p9 vs 160,175 on p5). Both printed; no fix.

p9 General Transfers - out (167,023) includes 6,848 to the Library sub-fund; the p5 statement General column (General + Library combined) prints (160,175) = 167,023 - 6,848. Gap -6,848 is this internal General-to-Library transfer, recorded gross in detail[] (Library's matching 6,848 in). Both printed; no fix.

p7 proprietary statement counts Insurance proceeds 11,999 (Water and Sewer) as a non-operating receipt: business-type receipts 180,485 operating + 11,999 insurance proceeds + 112 interest = 192,596. The p10 all-funds schedule prints the same 11,999 under OTHER FINANCING SOURCES (USES) (Water and Sewer column), and detail[] keeps it there (section other financing), so the detail revenue total is 57,777 + 122,673 + 112 + 35 = 180,597. 192,596 - 180,597 = 11,999 = gap. Classification differs between the two printed pages; no amount missing; no fix.
